notes: Find-a-part now shows where the shop stocks any part - bin + quantity - even parts not on your truck, with one-tap request to add. Parts the shop doesn't carry under your exact number now point you to the closest match's shelf. Find-a-part no longer crashes. Messages are now private 1:1 chats with the parts desk and teammates; team posts are read-only. Plus a 'type it instead' option when a barcode won't scan, and Home/navigation fixes.
